title: build.zig 'test-integration-svc' step name implies scoped SVC-01..04 subset but runs the full integration suite (same defect as ISS-0104)
notes: Incidental finding during ISS-0104 (GH-362) Step 1 diagnosis. build.zig lines ~2478-2490 define svc_integration_tests with root_source_file = 'tests/integration/main_test.zig'. This is the same root as the primary integration_tests artifact. The step description says 'Run Stage 13 SVC-01..SVC-04 integration tests' but actually compiles and runs the full ~700-test suite. Identical defect to ISS-0104 (env_integration_tests). Fix: create tests/integration/svc_test_root.zig importing only svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig, svc02_plugin_dispatch_scope_test.zig, svc03_definition_activation_scope_test.zig, svc04_admin_api_test.zig, then update svc_integration_tests.root_module.root_source_file and attach to test_integration_others_step per ISS-0150 policy.
candidate_resolution: Create tests/integration/svc_test_root.zig as a thin shim importing the four SVC test files, update svc_integration_tests root to svc_test_root.zig, and attach run_svc_integration_tests to test_integration_others_step per ISS-0150 policy. Mirrors the ISS-0104 fix.
